archetypes.name: merge-log-path
archetypes.rationale: Post-ensure flush and push ordering is the highest integration risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the merge-eligible ship path from ensure_pr through the first CI monitor call. Focus on whether the strict flush and push occur only on intended paths, whether stalls preserve terminal state, and whether no post-merge commit path was introduced. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: manifest-reconcile
archetypes.rationale: Manifest status and steps_ran reconciliation changed shared run-log semantics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review final_report and run_logs manifest reconciliation behavior. Verify summary write ordering, strict failure propagation, skip_tracking_upsert behavior, and preservation of reloaded steps_ran values across flush commits. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: audit-tolerance
archetypes.rationale: Historical stale-bail tolerance must not mask corrupt or genuinely incomplete runs.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review audit-runs and verify-completeness tolerance for stale bailed headings with PR evidence. Check that corrupt manifests stay strict, PR matching is conservative, and required-file checks still surface missing artifacts instead of fabricating completeness. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
